MAT361 -> Ads1 Sir is a good faculty. His classes are mostly dull because he jokes a lot, most of which are lame, I would say. Although I could understand what he taught, I didn't like his way of teaching. He doesn't teach the theoretical stuff, which is rather essential if you are planning to do CSE445 and CSE465 in the future. So, I would advise you to learn those by yourself.
If you just want a good grade, attend all his classes and note his lectures correctly. In the course outline, you will find a page containing the name of the exercises and the question numbers associated with each exercise. Make sure you practice those after each class and before the exam. He might or might not curve depending on the overall performance of the section. However, it's very much possible to score 95+ marks easily if you are regular and hardworking.
Overall, this course is easy, and since Ads1 Sir is chill, you will barely face any difficulties. However, it's necessary to be regular.

Mid usually 70/75 marks e nen pore 30 te convert koren and final 50 te nisen pore etawo convert hoise. Question pattern: There will be 3 sections A,b,c or 1,2,3 types First there will be Mcqs then True/false, in both sections you Have to write justification for your answers. In the third part there will be one or two Scenario based questions. For 323 it will be a math from the slides. For 327 sir will give a scenario and based on that you have to answer and justify it briefly. (All topics will come from the slides).
Now comes the grading part, here sir can be unpredictable sometimes. The reason is until midterm he will give you a lot of marks, even if your mcq gets wrong but you wrote justification, you will end up with half marks and don’t lose it. Because in Final he won’t give any marks for wrong answers. So you might expect that you got less marks then what you deserved, but it Isn’t actually!
Lastly, you won't find a super easygoing faculty like him. Thats all.
